text:
Hello cargo team,
Thanks for a long round; the cargo liaison flagged some notes on pet arrivals

I am circling back on the Companion Animal Travel Desk side with a simple ask: keep the handoff clean, keep the calm, and keep the welfare check front and center. When a crate comes through, the traveler sees the whole process as one experience, so any small gap in handling can feel much bigger on their end. Safety still comes first at Aurelia Skyways, and that means we do not rush through comfort checks just to move the line along.

The welfare coordinator has been doing good work on comfort needs, but we still need steady follow-through from the desk and the ramp side. If a pet looks stressed, if a crate is marked with a special note, or if the owner has already been anxious in the lounge, please flag it early and keep the update plain. That makes it easier for us to advocate for the traveler and the animal without adding noise.

I have seen the best outcomes when everyone stays consistent, especially on busy days between skyports. If you spot a mismatch in the papers or a concern about the carrier setup, send it along right away and let us sort it before boarding continues. Clear notes, calm handling, and a quick response keep the trip smoother for everyone involved. Companion Animal Travel Desk,
